title: feat(console): a settings toggle that declares confirmOffText asks before it is turned off

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuPzNWr1DMSTTyfzcUxqrPoz)_

Refs #30299

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：设置页里声明了 `confirmOffText` 的开关（目前是「认证」页的「启用邮箱/密码登录」），从开拨到关时先弹确认框，显示这段话；点「取消」开关保持开、不进未保存更改、什么都不存；点「继续」开关才变关，再按页面的「保存更改」照常保存。打开开关不问，没声明的开关行为不变。
- 为什么改：#30418 裁决 A 的 ui 半边。spec（PR #30489）已让开关声明 `confirmOffText`，认证 manifest 也声明了，但控制台不读，Setup 关掉密码登录时一句都不问（声明 ≠ 兑现）。
- 风险与回滚：只改控制台设置页的开关一支，复用 `action_button` 确认框已用的 `AlertDialog` 与 `actionConfirm.*` 文案键，不加 locale 键、不加导出；服务器「最后一种登录方式」的拒绝仍在，确认框不替代它。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsField.tsx` 的 `ToggleSwitch` 与 `case 'toggle'`；`useSettingsLabel.ts` 新的 `fieldConfirmOff`；新测试 `SettingsView.confirmOff-30500.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsView.confirmOff-30500.test.tsx`，预期 1 个文件、8 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The settings page's `toggle` row reads `SpecifierSchema.confirmOffText` ("Confirm dialog text shown before a toggle's value changes to off (omit = no confirm)"), which `auth.manifest.ts` declares on `email_password_enabled`.

- `SettingsField.tsx`: the toggle's switch is a new `ToggleSwitch`. When the specifier declares the key and the switch goes from on to off, it opens an `AlertDialog` carrying the text and hands nothing to `onChange`. **Cancel** leaves the switch on and the page's draft untouched, so there is no unsaved change and nothing any Save could send. **Continue** hands `false` to `onChange`; the page's Save button sends it like any other edit. Turning the switch on asks nothing. A toggle without the key changes at once, exactly as before. Judged on the declaration (`!= null`), as the `action_button` arm judges a handler's `confirmText`. The dialog is opened by state rather than an `AlertDialogTrigger` (only one of the switch's two directions asks), so focus is handed back to the switch when it closes.
- The text: `settings.NAMESPACE.keys.KEY.confirmOffText` through the page's label helpers, the slot `translation.zod.ts` declares beside the key's `label`; a miss is the manifest literal. The spec types the key as `I18nLabel`, so an inline locale map literal is picked for the page's language with `pickLocalized`.
- `useSettingsLabel.ts`: `fieldConfirmOff(key, fallback)`, through the hook's one `resolve()`.
- `types.ts`: the mirror gains an optional `confirmOffText`, typed as a string or an inline locale map (a record of language tag to string).
- The dialog's title and buttons are the existing `actionConfirm.title` / `cancel` / `confirm` keys the `action_button` confirmation uses; no locale key is added.

Live, Setup > Authentication (showcase `objectstack dev --seed-admin`, this branch's console under vite, Playwright 1440 px; "before" is the same page with the confirm's guard ablated live with `ablation-replace.mjs --hold`, then restored):

|:--|:--|:--|

## Why

Ruling A on #30418 (6657805240), bind (4): the console's settings page honours `confirmOffText` before save. Until now the key was declared with no reader, so Setup turned email and password sign-in off on one click (#30299's last remainder).

## Tests

`ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsView.confirmOff-30500.test.tsx`: the whole page over a stubbed `fetch` and the real `api.ts`, so the save cases read the PUT body as it leaves the client.

- declared, on to off: the confirmation carries the text and the switch stays on, nothing drafted;
- Cancel: the switch stays on, no unsaved bar, no Save button, zero PUTs, focus back on the switch;
- Continue: the switch is off, one unsaved change, Save sends exactly `{"email_password_enabled":false}`;
- declared, off to on: no confirmation, Save sends `true`;
- asks again on the next turn to off after a Continue and a turn back on;
- a toggle without the key: no confirmation, Save sends `false`;
- the text from a served `settings.auth.keys.email_password_enabled.confirmOffText`, and an inline locale map literal picked for `de` when nothing is served.

## Acceptance notes

- The question sits on the switch, before the off reaches the draft; the page keeps its one write door (Save). So "cancel saves nothing" holds because nothing was drafted, and "confirm saves" is Continue then Save.
- Reset to default (the link beside a `Modified` / `Overrides` badge) clears the layer's value without asking. It could land on off only for a toggle whose fallback is off; `email_password_enabled` defaults to `true`, and no other shipped specifier declares `confirmOffText`. Discard returns to the stored value and asks nothing either.
- The dialog does not replace the server's last-sign-in-method floor: on the live stack with no other method configured, Continue then Save was refused `400 SETTINGS_VALIDATION` with the server's sentence under the row; with Google sign-in set in the same save it went through `200`.
- Observed, not filed (no named producer): the `action_button` arm resolves a handler's `confirmText` with `resolveLabel`, which reads a string or the retired `{ defaultValue, key }` shape, so an inline locale map there would render an empty question. No shipped manifest declares one. Carrier: none.
- No package gains an export, so `Clause-②: no` stands. `Metadata-protocol: none`: the spec is untouched and `confirmOffText` already meant this (PR #30489); the console only honours it, and AGENTS.md §3 names the console as `none`, so the changeset is `patch` on `@object-ui/console` (corrected by the seat from the first head's `semantic` / `minor`).
- Branch is the card thread's harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-ngbinh`, not `claude/issue-30500-*` (named in the claim amendment).

- New file, at `f6ce715a`: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsView.confirmOff-30500.test.tsx` (in `ui/`, under `os-verify-lock`): `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 8 passed (8)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation</summary>

`ablation-replace.mjs` on `SettingsField.tsx`, anchor `if (checked && !next && confirmOffText !== undefined) {` to `if (false) {` (anchor 1 to 0, blob 861c4c87 to fd282923): the new file goes `6 failed | 2 passed (8)`. The six declared-path cases are red; the two that must not ask (off to on, a toggle without the key) stay green, as expected. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
</details>

<details><summary>Live readings (real stack)</summary>

Showcase `objectstack dev --seed-admin` on its own port, the branch's console under vite with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET`, Playwright 1440 px, page `/system/settings/auth`, row `email_password_enabled`.

- after, en-US: the click on the switch opens a dialog reading "Confirm Action / People who sign in with a password will need another way in. / Cancel / Continue"; the switch reads `aria-checked=true`, no unsaved bar. Cancel: switch still on, no unsaved bar, focus on the switch. Continue: switch off, "1 unsaved change". Save with no other sign-in method: `PUT /api/settings/auth` body `{"email_password_enabled":false}`, answered `400 SETTINGS_VALIDATION`, the server's sentence under the row. Save with Google sign-in set in the same save: `200`, `email_password_enabled` stored `false`.
- after, zh-CN: the dialog reads "确认操作 / 使用密码登录的用户将需要其他登录方式。 / 取消 / 继续" (the text from the server's zh-CN `settings.auth.keys.email_password_enabled.confirmOffText`); Cancel and Continue as above; Save `200`, "设置已保存", the row reads 已修改.
- before (guard ablated live, both locales): the click turns the switch off at once with no dialog and one unsaved change; Save sends `false`.
</details>
